3. AWARD TO PRIVATE BUSINESS: PURCHASE OF A CCTV VAN: 
Move to approve the sole source purchase of a CCTV Van from CUES, Inc. in an amount not to exceed $335,145. Department of Environmental Services is the lead department. 
 C-3 
 D. PUBLIC HEARING: 45 Minutes

attachments.name: C-3
attachments.text:
City Council
:
Agenda Item Type Decision
Award to Private Business: Purchase of a CCTV Van
Agenda Item Number: C-3 Service Area Manager: Steve Fancher
Meeting Date: October 1, 2024 Service Area: Environmental Services
REQUESTED COUNCIL ACTION & SUGGESTED MOTION
Move to approve the sole source purchase of a CCTV Van from CUES, Inc. in an amount not
to exceed $335,145.
PUBLIC PURPOSE, COMMUNITY OUTCOME, AND STRATEGIC PLAN ALIGNMENT
The CCTV Van allows stormwater operations crews to inspect pipes and provide condition
assessments that allow for timely repair and replacement of the City’s stormwater collection
system.
BACKGROUND
The stormwater operations department is responsible for the operations, maintenance, and
management of over 242 miles of main line pipe and 200 culverts. The City has typically
utilized CUES CCTV inspection systems to thoroughly inspect and evaluate the condition of the
stormwater collection system. CUES systems are used by stormwater and wastewater
operations teams, which enhances interoperability and consistency for unit operators. City staff
is not confident that alternative units would support the same level of service. Per the City’s
operations superintendents, there are no competitive options that would satisfy the City’s
operational needs. The lack of competitive options justifies this being a sole source purchase.
The inspection system includes CUES CCTV equipment, computer hardware and software,
and a van to house the equipment. In addition to routine, scheduled inspections, this
equipment also supports timely evaluation of emergency line blockages to prevent flooding and
sinkholes. The equipment also is used to inspect new development and CIP projects.
The stormwater division currently uses a CCTV van that was originally purchased in 2012. This
unit is past its useful life, and its replacement is included in the approved fiscal year 2024/25
budget within the Equipment Replacement Fund.
RECOMMENDATION AND ALTERNATIVES
Recommendation:
Move to approve the sole source purchase of a CCTV Van from CUES, Inc. in an amount not
to exceed $335,145.
Alternatives:
1. City develops a formal request for proposal (RFP). Qualified manufacturers who produce
CCTV vans are limited, and this option is likely to delay replacement without significant
savings for the City.
1
No Action:
Stormwater operations teams will continue to use the existing unit at risk of failure which would
compromise the timely identification of critical repairs.
BUDGET / FINANCIAL IMPACT
The CCTV Van is included in the fiscal year 2024/25 approved budget within the Equipment
Replacement Fund. As such, stormwater has contributed internal service charges for this
replacement since the purchase of the last unit.
PUBLIC INVOLVEMENT
This purchase is a sole source procurement.
NEXT STEPS
If Council approves this purchase, City staff will purchase the CCTV van from CUES, Inc.
